title: Outlook: new Outlook for Windows for GCC High and DoD tenants
notes: claim 72: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
the verifier wrote "hold" but listed no blocker and fewer than three majors; the claims decide, so the page is not held
summary: Hold: the impact rationale incorrectly says only pilot users get the app, although the briefing and Microsoft document Windows preinstallation. The roadmap facts, sovereign-cloud configuration and mailbox access commands are supported, but the licensing qualifications and conflicting guidance behind the cross-tenant example need clarification.
